title: Right-fibration sections test a specified limit cone of spaces
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent diagrams, internal functor simplicial sets, cores, Kan complexes and limiting cones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the space category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], right fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and join cones of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Fix a universe $\mathcal W$ and a containing universe for its space category. Let $B$ be a $\mathcal W$-small quasicategory, let $F:B^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ be a coherent functor, and let $r:E\to B$ be a $\mathcal W$-small right fibration classified by $F$, meaning that its opposite left fibration corresponds to $F$ under [lem-coef-space-valued-straightening]. Let $K$ be a $\mathcal W$-small simplicial set, define its right join cone by $K^{\triangleright}=K\star\Delta^0$, and let $a:K^{\triangleright}\to B$ be a coherent diagram. For a simplicial subset $J\subseteq K^{\triangleright}$ define a simplicial set of sections by
$$\Gamma_J(E,a)_n=\{s:J\times\Delta^n\to E\mid rs=(a|_J)\operatorname{pr}_J\},$$
with operators given by precomposition on $\Delta^n$. The section simplicial sets for $J=K^{\triangleright}$ and $J=K$ are Kan complexes. The specified cone $F\circ a^{\mathrm{op}}:(K^{\triangleright})^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ is limiting if and only if restriction
$$\Gamma_{K^{\triangleright}}(E,a)\longrightarrow\Gamma_K(E,a)$$
is a homotopy equivalence of Kan complexes. Equivalently this map is an equivalence of spaces, so all its homotopy fibers are contractible. No quasicategory or nonemptiness assumption on $K$ is imposed.

source.place: Corollary 3.3.3.3, printed p. 216, applied to the opposite left fibration over $(K^{\triangleright})^{\mathrm{op}}$; no Stacks tag.
